items.question: From which location are the vowels beginning with ḷkāra to be placed in this nyāsa?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe an initial nyāsa of vowels in sequence.
This verse refers to vowels beginning with ḷkāra.
The placement is to be done likewise from the right palm.
items.inference: Therefore, the vowels beginning with ḷkāra are also to be placed in sequence from the right palm.
uncertainties: The exact range of vowels included by 'beginning with ḷkāra' depends on the text's phonetic scheme.
